message: Hi! I want to try mma for myself. How do I start?

Hey! I'm Emma from Mythic Martial Arts. Great to hear from you! We'd love to help you get started. Just to make sure I point you in the right direction, are you interested in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu or our Cardio Kickboxing program?
Hi Emma! I'm interested in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. What are the next steps?

Awesome! The best way to start is with a free trial class, no commitment required. I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your hame?
*name

Perfect, thanks Testsr! What's the best email to send your trial details to?
*Tester
You can send the details to tester.clover@gmail.com.
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Last thing, what's your date of birth? This just helps us make sure you're in the right class group.

Great! You're all set. Let's get your free trial booked. Here are some open times for Adult Foundations Jiu-Jitsu:

Monday 7/13 at 6:00 AM
Monday 7/13 at 5:30 PM
Tuesday 7/14 at 5:30 PM

Which works best for you?
I'll take the Monday 7/13 at 5:30 PM slot!

Perfect! You're all booked for Monday, July 13th at 5:30 PM for your free trial class. We'll send a confirmation to tester.clover@gmail.com. Just wear comfortable workout clothes and we'll provide everything else. See you then!
